# Generated mirror - do not edit here

These 22 files are copied byte for byte from `boxes/` in [zao-icm](https://github.com/bettercallzaal/zao-icm) at commit `fd1dac84eb0ee40b8ee2d3a5f368baec434844ab`.

zao-icm is the master copy (Zaal, 2026-10-11, decisions item 135). The same text is served at https://context.thezao.com/<name>.

To change a box, open a PR in zao-icm. To refresh this folder, run `python3 bin/mirror-to-zaoos.py --zaoos <this repo>` from a zao-icm checkout and open a PR here. `MANIFEST.json` lists every file with its sha256.
